_comment: Single source of truth for the built-in world registry. worlds.py loads this into WORLDS. Each entry's `template` names a folder under neonrp/templates/ (instantiated via load_game_template). `mode` is fast|orch|multi-agent. `hidden` keeps an entry out of the world picker (e.g. soul-talk is a character mode). Covers live in the public examples/ repo + hub, NOT in the wheel — the CLI/TUI does not render them.
